tools.name: get_storm_history

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_property_storm_history_report · Private data: get_storm_history, get_risk_forecast, get_property_storm_history_report, get_address_report · Public sink: get_property_storm_history_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_property_storm_history_report · Private data: get_storm_history, get_risk_forecast, get_property_storm_history_report, get_address_report · Public sink: get_property_storm_history_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
